response.heroTitle: Your hardware shop, online, with its own link.
response.heroText: Customers browse your cement, steel and mabati and pay by M-PESA. You run the counter, stock and credit from the same place.
response.featuresTitle: One account runs your online store and your shop counter.
response.feature1Title: A store your customers can open on their phone
response.feature1Text: Your shop gets its own link to share on WhatsApp, Facebook and your signboard. Customers see what you stock, your prices per bag, length or metre, and pay by M-PESA.
response.feature1Points:
Your logo, location and opening hours
Pickup or delivery, your choice
Request a quote for big orders
response.feature2Title: A till that sells the way a hardware counter does
response.feature2Text: Sell 20 bags of cement, 6 lengths of Y12 and 30 metres of cable in one sale. Take M-PESA, cash, bank or credit, and send the receipt on WhatsApp.
response.feature2Points:
Units you actually use: bags, lengths, kg, feet
Works on any phone, tablet or laptop
Every sale recorded with who made it
response.feature3Title: Know your stock, and who owes you
response.feature3Text: Every sale updates your stock. Topline tells you what is running low before a fundi asks for it, and keeps a clear record of every customer on credit.
response.feature3Points:
Low-stock alerts
Credit limits, due dates and WhatsApp reminders
Profit and loss, and expenses, in Accounting
response.suppliersTitle: Buy straight from manufacturers and distributors
response.suppliersText: Shops on Topline see each supplier’s products and prices and send orders from their shop admin. The supplier calls back to confirm delivery and payment.
response.suppliersEmpty: We’re signing up cement plants, steel mills and manufacturers abroad, including China. They’ll be listed here soon.
response.suppliersJoinText: Manufacturer or distributor? Sign up, and once Topline approves you, every hardware shop on Topline can order from you.
response.creditText: Stock up now and pay later, with credit from Topline’s lending partner based on your shop’s sales on Topline. Shop owners request it from their shop admin.
response.step1Text: Your name, the shop name, where you are and your WhatsApp number. It takes about three minutes.
response.step2Title: Pick a plan and pay by M-PESA
response.step2Text: Approve the M-PESA prompt on your phone. Your store link goes live as soon as the payment comes through.
response.step3Title: Add products and share your link
response.step3Text: Add what you sell with prices per unit, then share your link with customers and fundis.
response.pricingText: Pay monthly or yearly by M-PESA or card. No setup fee, and you can change plan at any time.
response.pricingNote: Prices are placeholders until Topline confirms final pricing.
response.faqs: [{"q":"Do I need a computer?","a":"No. Topline works on any smartphone browser. A tablet or laptop at the counter is handy for busy shops."},{"q":"How do customers pay me?","a":"By M-PESA on your store page. The money goes to your account, not to Topline. You can also record cash, bank and credit sales at the counter."},{"q":"What happens if I stop paying?","a":"You get reminders and a 7-day grace period. After that your store shows as closed to customers, but your records stay safe and come back the moment you pay."},{"q":"Can I use my own website address?","a":"Every store gets a free link like yourshop.toplinehub.co.ke. Using your own domain is coming soon."},{"q":"Does it do KRA eTIMS invoices?","a":"eTIMS support is on the way for VAT-registered shops. Tell us if you need it and we will put you on the early list."}]
response.closingTitle: Your customers are already on their phones.
response.closingText: Give them a link to your shop.
response.reviewsTitle: Tell us how a shop treated you
response.reviewsText: We value your feedback. Reviews go only to the Topline team, never to the shop or the public, and help us keep every hardware shop on Topline honest and helpful.
response.footerText: Shop software and an online store for hardware businesses in Kenya. Paid by M-PESA.
